goal: Extract attribute key/validation and HTML boolean-attribute responsibilities into a new cohesive helper class to reduce public method count and total methods in Attribute.

expected_impact.rationale: Move the public static helpers getValidKey(...) and isBooleanAttribute(...), plus their supporting static fields and validators (xml/html regex patterns and validation helpers) into a new AttributeKeyValidator class. This reduces Attribute's public method count by 2 and removes several static helper methods/patterns, lowering total methods and LOC and isolating the attribute-key/boolean-attribute responsibility.

ops.details: Create new class org.jsoup.nodes.AttributeKeyValidator that owns the responsibility of attribute-key validation and HTML boolean-attribute detection. Moved members: - private static final String[] booleanAttributes - private static final Pattern xmlKeyReplace - private static final Pattern htmlKeyReplace - public static String getValidKey(String key, Document.OutputSettings.Syntax syntax) - public static boolean isBooleanAttribute(String key) - private static boolean isValidXmlKey(String key) - private static boolean isValidHtmlKey(String key) The new class will live in the same package (org.jsoup.nodes) and keep getValidKey and isBooleanAttribute as public static so callers can reference them. Removed these members from Attribute. The extraction groups together a single cohesive responsibility: validating/coercing attribute keys and checking boolean attribute names.

Update internal references in Attribute to reference the new class: replace calls to getValidKey(key, out.syntax()) with AttributeKeyValidator.getValidKey(key, out.syntax()), and replace Attribute.isBooleanAttribute(key) with AttributeKeyValidator.isBooleanAttribute(key). Remove the moved static fields and helper methods from Attribute. Keep Attribute package as org.jsoup.nodes so no import is required to use AttributeKeyValidator.

Adjust imports in Attribute to remove imports no longer needed after extraction (e.g., Pattern, Arrays, Normalizer if unused). Add imports required by AttributeKeyValidator (java.util.Arrays, java.util.regex.Pattern, org.jsoup.internal.Normalizer, org.jsoup.nodes.Document.OutputSettings.Syntax) and any others needed for compilation.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
